ledgerPresentation.accountBoundary.source: Account totals include verified Google and wallet sign-ins. Each wallet is counted once; one person may use several wallets.
ledgerPresentation.accountBoundary.text: 账户总数包括经核验的 Google 和钱包登录。每个钱包计一次；一个人可能使用多个钱包。

ledgerPresentation.guestBoundary.source: Guest questions are included in recorded questions: completed web questions with no signed-in wallet recorded. This counts questions, not visits or unique people.
ledgerPresentation.guestBoundary.text: 访客问题包含在已记录问题中：没有记录登录钱包的已完成网页问题。这统计问题数，不是访问量或独立人数。

ledgerPresentation.settlementBoundary.source: Research settlements include creator rewards and Keryx operating fees, shown separately. Public citations and planned allocations require payment settlement evidence before they count in these totals.
ledgerPresentation.settlementBoundary.text: 研究结算包括分别显示的创作者奖励和 Keryx 运营费。公开引用和计划分配需有付款结算证据才计入总额。

ledgerPresentation.totalsBoundary.source: Amounts in USDC. Settled volume includes the separately listed operating fees. Only settled records count.
ledgerPresentation.totalsBoundary.text: 金额以 USDC 计。已结算金额包括单独列出的运营费。仅计入已结算记录。

ledgerPresentation.claimSource.text: 发布作品？认领您的来源 →

ledgerPresentation.referencesBoundary.source: Individual payment references identify Circle Gateway batch settlements. Creator cash-outs link to their own Arc transactions. Each record retains its original network.
ledgerPresentation.referencesBoundary.text: 各付款参考标识 Circle Gateway 批次结算。创作者提现链接到其 Arc 交易。每条记录保留原始网络。

ledgerPresentation.pending.one.source: {count} signed authorization(s), ${amount} USDC, await settlement proof and are excluded from settled totals.
ledgerPresentation.pending.one.text: {count} 项签名授权，${amount} USDC，等待结算凭证，未计入已结算总额。

ledgerPresentation.pending.other.source: {count} signed authorization(s), ${amount} USDC, await settlement proof and are excluded from settled totals.
ledgerPresentation.pending.other.text: {count} 项签名授权，${amount} USDC，等待结算凭证，未计入已结算总额。

ledgerPresentation.failed.one.source: {count} Circle-terminal attempt(s) failed and were not charged; ${amount} USDC is excluded from settled totals.
ledgerPresentation.failed.one.text: {count} 次 Circle 终态尝试失败且未收费；${amount} USDC 未计入已结算总额。

ledgerPresentation.failed.other.source: {count} Circle-terminal attempt(s) failed and were not charged; ${amount} USDC is excluded from settled totals.
ledgerPresentation.failed.other.text: {count} 次 Circle 终态尝试失败且未收费；${amount} USDC 未计入已结算总额。

paymentRecords.batchBoundary.source: Settlement IDs are Circle Gateway references (batched on-chain on Arc), not per-tx EVM hashes — verify via the settlement wallet linked above.
paymentRecords.batchBoundary.text: 结算 ID 是 Circle Gateway 参考标识（在 Arc 链上批量处理），不是每笔交易的 EVM 哈希；可通过上方结算钱包核验。

paymentRecords.empty.source: No payments yet — run a query on the Ask page.
paymentRecords.empty.text: 尚无付款，请在提问页运行查询。

paymentRecords.operatingBoundary.source: Operating fee for research; recorded separately from creator rewards.
paymentRecords.operatingBoundary.text: 研究运营费，与创作者奖励分开记录。

paymentRecords.settlementTitle.source: Circle Gateway settlement ID {reference} — batched on-chain on Arc (not a per-tx EVM hash)
paymentRecords.settlementTitle.text: Circle Gateway 结算 ID {reference}，在 Arc 链上批量处理（不是每笔交易的 EVM 哈希）

ledgerPresentation.publicHistoryBoundary.source: Recorded totals include all recorded questions. This list shows only questions made public and excludes scripted runs.
ledgerPresentation.publicHistoryBoundary.text: 记录总数包含所有已记录的问题。此列表仅显示已公开的问题，并排除脚本运行。

ledgerPresentation.noPublicQuestions.text: 暂无可显示的公开问题。
